description:
REQUIREMENT: 
 We need a programmer with the listed skills below. The resource will be building a staging and production area using the proprietary CMS . The resource will also be utilized build an editor/stager environment before we can allow any of the section editors into the new CMS. This programmer will secure assets within the CMS. This programmer will switch the GUIDs to names (urls, document names, image names etc.). Also, build a recycle bin for deleted items. Work on creating a roles management/security piece to the website and CMS. 
 

 

 Ability to write Web based programs for various purposes. This requires an understanding of and practical experience with the programming technologies we use (C#, ASP.Net, Model-View-Controller (MVC), JQuery, Bootstrap, HTML 5, JavaScript, JSON, AJAX, CSS, XML, XSLT, and SQL Server). Developing software requires one to think logically and to conceptualize complex abstract ideas to solve problems. System design, system development and system testing using the platforms, tools, and languages in place for this team. 
 Education, Degree, Licenses Certifications required by this position is as follows: Post high school study in computer science, information systems, or related area is helpful, but preference will be given for working knowledge and experience with the tools listed. 
 The Programmer will need to communicate information clearly and concisely in writing, will need to read and comprehend information presented in writing, and speak clearly, concisely and effectively. The programmer will need to listen to and comprehend information and ideas presented visually and orally, interact with people in a friendly and cheerful manner that shows tact, professionalism and sensitivity, and be able to work with a team or independently. 
 


 Raj Talukdar
